title: Levi Sarisa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In the Jerusalem Talmud, Shabbat, chapter 3, end of halakhah 3, and Beitzah 2:5, Avlam (Shmuel’s colleague, one of the nations of the world) asked him a question. It appears that the reading should be Levi bar Sisi, for when Levi came to Nehardea in Babylonia he met Avlam, a sage of the nations of the world.
And in Gittin ch. 6, halakhah 5, Rabbi Hanina relates this incident: “Levi Perisa was passing by.” Possibly this should read “Levi bar Sisi.”

notes.text: Hyman writes Avlam, whereas the checked Shabbat passage names Ablat. His proposed identifications of Sarisa and Perisa with Levi bar Sisi remain conjectures.
